key_path: human signs up at github.com/signup: email, password, username, visual/audio captcha puzzle, email 'launch code' verification
`gh auth login` (web device flow: one-time code entered at github.com/login/device)
`gh auth token` prints an OAuth token usable as an API key (scopes repo, read:org, gist); or Settings > Developer settings > fine-grained PAT

MCP: `claude mcp add-json github '{"type":"http","url":"https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp","headers":{"Authorization":"Bearer <PAT>"}}'` (PAT required for Claude Code). OAuth only works in hosts with a pre-registered GitHub App (VS Code, Claude.ai/Desktop, Cursor)
human_gates: 2fa (mandatory for most github.com users; enrolment enforced after signup)

agent_native_auth.cli_device_flow: yes: `gh auth login` device flow; the local github-mcp-server also has a built-in OAuth / device-code fallback
agent_native_auth.mcp_oauth_dcr: no: protected-resource metadata points to https://github.com/login/oauth, which publishes no RFC 8414 metadata or registration endpoint. README: 'Each MCP host application needs to configure a GitHub App or OAuth App'
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: no API to mint PATs. GitHub Apps can mint short-lived installation tokens; `gh auth token` reuses the CLI OAuth token
agent_native_auth.scoped_tokens: yes: fine-grained PATs (per-repo, per-permission, expiry) and GitHub App tokens

remote.auth: OAuth (pre-registered hosts only) or PAT bearer

mcp.local: docker ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server or native binary; built-in OAuth login (callback port 8085) or GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
mcp.type: product only (repos, issues, PRs, Actions, code security). Docs search not included per llms.txt
mcp.one_click: VS Code, VS Code Insiders, Visual Studio install buttons; Docker variants; per-host guides (Claude, Cursor, Copilot CLI, JetBrains...)

docs_for_agents.markdown_pages: yes via https://docs.github.com/api/article/body?pathname=... (text/markdown), Page List API and Search API
docs_for_agents.use_with_ai_page: Copilot MCP docs; AGENTS.md / copilot-instructions.md conventions supported by Copilot coding agent

autonomy_note: About 1 minute if the user already has an account (gh device flow then reuse the token for MCP). The new-account path has captcha and email gates.
score_justification: gh device flow and fine-grained PATs are excellent and nearly every agent already has an account. Signup is heavily gated, the remote MCP has no DCR so non-blessed clients need a PAT, and there is no docs MCP.
best_practice: Docs Article/Search APIs that return markdown, documented in llms.txt as the preferred LLM access path
biggest_gap: Remote MCP OAuth only works for hosts with a pre-registered GitHub App (no DCR), so most CLI agents fall back to copying a PAT by hand
